intro: Durable and versatile, Core units structure team zones with easy-access storage. A reliable foundation for busy offices.

features.title: Robust All-Metal Design
features.text: Fully metal construction with Transparent tempered glass doors, offering clear visibility and quick access to contents.

features.title: Soft-Closing Hinges
features.text: Doors close gently and silently with soft-closing hinges, adding to a premium feel.

features.title: Versatile Placement
features.text: Sized to integrate seamlessly into team areas, it doubles as shared storage in open or breakout spaces.

features.title: Secure Cam Lock
features.text: Lockable hinged doors ensure items remain protected even in high-traffic, shared-use areas.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
